natural_language: Production Natural query intent with fuzzy and synonym expansion disabled. Original query text supplies the frozen embedding; generated lexical terms do not become mandatory constraints on hybrid retrieval.
policy: All test queries count in every mean; failed and zero-result queries score zero. One warm run per mode/query after ten unmeasured warmup queries. No test-judgment tuning or query removal.

preparation.scope: Public English scientific-abstract retrieval; not a user-corpus, OCR, multilingual, or full-desktop qualification

receipt_note: Complete aggregate result retains exact preparation and execution metadata, all six mode metrics, every failed-query entry, denominators, source hashes, and the raw trace hash. Raw query/source text, model weights, vectors, and per-query traces remain outside Git. Compare the six modes within this run: regenerated embedding bytes differ from the earlier receipt despite matching pinned model, inputs, and inference configuration. Modes ran sequentially once in the listed order (strict lexical, literal any-term, dense, advanced hybrid, natural lexical, natural hybrid), each after 10 unmeasured warm-up queries; there was no randomized mode order or repeated measured pass. Development-profile native timings are diagnostic and exclude model inference, HTTP, UI, extraction, and desktop rendering; they are not a randomized performance comparison or a desktop latency claim.
scope: Production server index, CPU model inference prepared separately. Native retrieval latency excludes embedding, HTTP, and UI. Public-corpus judgments are not a user-corpus or full-desktop qualification.
vector_index: Exact vector scan; no approximate vector index is built for this corpus
